Title: JYHAD: Out of Turn Master Question

Messages.Author: Christopher Esko
Messages.Body:
During a game last night, I tried to play the 'Frenzy' Out of turn
Master card during my minion phase when one of my vamps got into combat.
 Another player argued that I couldn't play the card because it was
still my turn.  The rulebook I recieved with the game says that I can
play a Out of Turn Master in leiu of my next Master phasel; the revised
rules say something like 'Out of Turn Master can only be played on your
opponent's turns.  Is this another helpful reminder that got screwed up
in the translation?

			Chris Esko

                             blacknight+@CMU.EDU
                             ce24+@andrew.cmu.edu
------------------------------------
           "It's just a flesh wound!" -The Black Knight

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Christopher Esko  <blacknight+@CMU.EDU> wrote:
>During a game last night, I tried to play the 'Frenzy' Out of turn
>Master card during my minion phase when one of my vamps got into combat.
>Another player argued that I couldn't play the card because it was
>still my turn...

You can't use out-of-turn cards during your own turn.
